---
title: "Survey questions and outcome indicators"
description-meta: "Browse ready-made survey questions and outcome indicators, organised by topic, to measure how business support changes the firms in your evaluation."
---

Two repositories help you measure what an intervention changes: tested survey questions for collecting data from firms,
and indicators that define what to measure, each with a plain-language definition and a metric. Both are organised by
topic and are a starting point to adapt, not a prescribed set.

## Survey question repository

Questions drawn from the Community Innovation Survey, World Bank surveys and other validated instruments.
[Open the survey question repository](08-bank_survey.qmd) for the sources and how to use them.

### Topics {.unlisted}

- [company details](08.01-bank_survey_company.qmd)
- [respondent details](08.02-bank_survey_respondent.qmd)
- [company structure and ownership](08.03-bank_survey_ownership.qmd)
- [company financial performance](08.04-bank_survey_performance.qmd)
- [collaboration](08.05-bank_survey_collab.qmd)
- [digitalisation and technology adoption](08.07-bank_survey_digital.qmd)
- [innovation, R&D activities, and intellectual property](08.08-bank_survey_innov.qmd)
- [technology readiness level](08.11-bank_survey_trl.qmd)
- [energy efficiency](08.12-bank_survey_energy.qmd)
- [business finance](08.13-bank_survey_finance.qmd)
- [business support and training](08.14-bank_survey_train.qmd)
- [management practices](08.15-bank_survey_mgmt.qmd)
- [competition](08.16-bank_survey_comp.qmd)

## Indicator repository

Indicators informed by the EuroCOMP Lab evaluations, World Bank reports and the OECD Oslo and Frascati manuals.
[Open the indicator repository](09-bank_outcomes.qmd) for the sources, how to use it and an example evaluation for each topic.

- [collaboration and knowledge transfer](09.06-bank_survey_collab.qmd)
